                         LogEntry( { 'level': LogLevel.INF, 'message': "Counter hexdump"})
                         ]
    
        LOGGER.info("Searching log messages:")

            for m in expected_logs:
                LOGGER.error("XXX Not FOUND ---> {0}".format(m.message))
        else:
            LOGGER.info("### All expected Log messages found!")
